note: item_text = the deposit's own Spanish column header for each item (level-1 source; the script renames each column to BARS_k by keyword match on that header, re-run cell for cell: 10/10 diagonal agreement 1.000, largest off-diagonal 0.706). item_text_translated = the paper's Appendix A.k heading, a word-for-word English rendering of that header in the same order (10/10). option_text = the five behavioural anchors printed against scale points 1..5 in Appendix A.k, transcribed by reading the embedded images (OCR-by-eye; spot-check advised). The anchors survive only in English: the deposit carries just the ten Spanish dimension headers and the paper prints no Spanish anchors, so option_text is the authors' own English (translated_substitute fallback, translation_source study_supplied) while language=Spanish records the administration (a Spanish university; Spanish deposit headers; deposit readme 'Language: Espanol / Ingles'). Administered Spanish anchor wording was not sought off-source per the recoverability rule. Literal deviations: bold-underlined NOT rendered as plain NOT; source typos kept as printed ('does NOT posts' in A.1 and A.2, 'does NOT answers' in A.7, 'whit' in A.8 point 5); a leading space in A.9 point 1 dropped. A.10 (General satisfaction) point 1 is printed positively ('Teacher demonstrates knowledge and appropriate management of the LMS resources...'), unlike the 'does NOT' point 1 of A.1-A.9; transcribed as printed. No instructions are printed in the paper; instructions left blank. Rights: Behav Sci article CC BY 4.0 and the originating NAER 2019 article CC BY 4.0; the instrument is the authors' own and no fee, permission, NC, ND or redistribution clause was found. resp direction: 1 = the least effective anchor, as the appendix numbers it; live per-item skewness rank-agrees with the paper's Table 1 (Spearman 0.891; -0.891 if reversed). DATA DISCREPANCY (not an itemtext defect): the deposit does not reproduce the paper's published statistics numerically - live kurtosis -1.19..-1.57 vs Table 1 -0.23..-0.73; live means 2.52-3.27 vs Table 6 2.75-3.55 (e.g. Organizational consistency 2.88 vs 3.55); and a 2-component varimax PCA of the live data puts only Course introduction/Evaluation system description on the second component (0.85/0.83) with Organizational consistency and Evaluation system implementation on the first (0.80/0.77), whereas Table 2 puts all four on Structure and Evaluation.
public_note: The behavioural anchors (option_text) are the authors' published English; respondents at a Spanish university answered a Spanish version whose anchor wording was not published, so only the dimension names (item_text) are the administered Spanish.
